page_title: NEW 4-4 LUT | Newcastle v Luton 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation.

90+9' Martin Dubravka is a nightmare for the offensive players! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
90+7' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul after Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) hacks down one of his opponents.
90+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+2' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
90' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Gabriel Osho (Luton) for a tough tackle.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cauley Woodrow (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Elijah Adebayo.
86' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Bruno Guimaraes, but his first-time effort flashes just over the bar.
84' Gabriel Osho (Luton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
83' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

82' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Thomas Kaminski. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' The referee blows his whistle as Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in his challenge.
79' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Reece Burke (Luton) replaces Alfie Doughty.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Jacob Brown (Luton) is brought on as a substitute for Carlton Morris.
78' Teden Mengi (Luton) commits a rough foul. Thomas Bramall stops the game and makes a call.
78' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
76' Today's referee Thomas Bramall rightly decides to book Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) for his harsh tackle.
73' 4 - 4 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
72' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Now Newcastle have a corner.
72' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Thomas Bramall couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Elijah Adebayo (Luton) and blew his whistle.
68' Today's match ends for Jordan Clark who will be replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
67' 3 - 4 Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
67' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
64' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Dan Burn is replaced by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
63' Miguel Almiron comes off the pitch to be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
62' 2 - 4 Elijah Adebayo (Luton) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
60' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Bramall didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
59' 2 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Carlton Morris (Luton) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Martin Dubravka no chance!
58' Carlton Morris (Luton) is going to take the penalty!
58' It’s a PENALTY to Luton after the VAR review!
56' Referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Luton. Let’s see what happens!
56' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
55' One of the Luton players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' Half-chance! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) plays a pass into the box, but Thomas Kaminski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
49' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:4.
46' The game is over for Anthony Gordon. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45+1' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Carlton Morris (Luton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
40' 2 - 2 Goal! Martin Dubravka makes a huge mistake and Ross Barkley (Luton) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.
40' Amari'i Bell (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Martin Dubravka comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
37' A player from Luton commits a rough challenge. Thomas Bramall blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Newcastle are awarded a free kick.
35' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
33' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) makes a slide tackle, but referee Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
32' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
31' Jordan Clark (Luton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
27' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
25' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
23' 2 - 1 Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and sends it goalwards, surprising the goalkeeper, who watches the ball go into the back of the net.
23' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski makes a comfortable save.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Nice headed pass by Carlton Morris to Gabriel Osho (Luton), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 1:1.
20' Luton are awarded the free kick. Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece.
19' The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
16' Carlton Morris (Luton) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
16' Luton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
7' 1 - 0 Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
4' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
